content: If the configuration parameter DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT_FIRST_ACTIVE , the value shall be calculated anal- ogous to DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT . The difference is, that in case the current aging counter has a value of 0 and the event status bits TestFailedThisOperationCycle and TestNotCompletedThisOperationCycle are set to False, a value of 1 is reported upon reading the Dem internal aging counter.
